description: Source code for managing automated user creation and test user setup in Mattermost, including functions for creating basic users, generating random users, and creating test users within the slashcommands package.

classes.name: AutoUserCreator
classes.description: A struct for automating user creation with configurable parameters such as email and name length, charset, and join time.

methods.name: NewAutoUserCreator
methods.description: Constructor for AutoUserCreator, initializes with app, client, and team.

methods.name: CreateTestUsers
methods.description: Creates multiple test users based on a specified range.

methods.name: createRandomUser
methods.description: Generates a single random user, optionally fuzzy, and adds to the system.
